title: hardhooks config
description: hardhooks configuration (.hardhooks.json or the user-level config.json).

preset.description: `standard` (default): Guards, format-on-edit and session-context on. `strict`: every Hook on, Guards tightened.

hooks.description: Per-Hook overrides: `enabled` plus that Hook's options. Anything left out comes from the Preset.

check.description: Runs the project's checks when the Host tries to stop, and blocks the stop while they fail.

enabled.description: Run this Hook. The default comes from the Preset.

command.description: Command line to run, through the platform shell (sh -c on POSIX, cmd.exe /d /s /c on Windows). Omit to autodetect.

outputBytes.description: Most bytes of failure output to put in the block reason, which enters the Host's context.

maxBlocks.description: Consecutive Stop blocks before check gives up and lets the Host stop. Keep it below Claude Code's own cap (8).

git-guard.description: Blocks git commands that rewrite shared history or destroy uncommitted work.

enabled.description: Run this Hook. The default comes from the Preset.
